name: Rocket Money
description: Rocket Money is a consumer finance application for linked accounts, transactions, subscriptions, budgets, bills, credit reports, net worth, savings, cancellations, and bill negotiation.
agentUseSummary: Rocket Money cannot currently be connected as an autonomous Relay provider. Rocket Money documents an interactive consumer account, Plaid-linked institutions, provider-operated agent features, and limited agency for cancellations and bill negotiation, but publishes no Relay-usable member API, remote MCP endpoint, OAuth scopes, stable tool schemas, service credentials, or revocation contract. Its terms prohibit scraping, automated extraction, and reverse engineering. Relay will not reuse sessions, capture credentials, or transfer Rocket Money's provider-specific agency to itself.

blocked.label: Connect Rocket Money through an unsupported session
blocked.description: Relay will not reuse a Rocket Money browser session, capture Rocket Money or institution credentials or tokens, automate consent, or reinterpret Plaid aggregation as member API authority.

blocked.label: Access private Rocket Money data
blocked.description: Accounts, balances, transactions, subscriptions, bills, spending, budgets, categories, tags, notes, credit reports and scores, assets, debts, net worth, savings goals, and shared-account information are blocked without a supported least-privilege member API.

blocked.label: Change financial records or move money
blocked.description: Transaction edits, splits, rules, budgets, goals, linked accounts, subscription or billing changes, automated savings, ACH debits, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and every other money action are blocked.

blocked.label: Cancel subscriptions or negotiate bills
blocked.description: Subscription cancellation, bill negotiation, provider impersonation, acceptance of third-party terms, communications, purchases, credit actions, and use of Rocket Money's limited power of attorney are not transferable to Relay and remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use unsupported Rocket Money automation
blocked.description: Dashboard scraping, robots, automated extraction, private endpoint discovery, UI automation, raw session pass-through, and reverse engineering are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Rocket Money action can be enabled without a supported public member authorization and tool contract designed for third-party autonomous use.

runtimeSupport.description: Rocket Money publishes no member-account API/MCP authorization or bounded tool contract that Relay can distribute as OpenClaw tools.
Rocket Money publishes no member-account API/MCP authorization or bounded tool contract that Relay can distribute as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Rocket Money is an interactive consumer finance application handling linked account credentials, transactions, credit information, subscriptions, budgets, savings, ACH activity, cancellations, and bill negotiation. Its Plaid connection and provider-operated agent/concierge authority are not a public third-party member API, and Rocket Money publishes no Relay-usable endpoint, scopes, stable schemas, service credentials, revocation lifecycle, or autonomous authorization boundary.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not expose Connect, request Rocket Money or institution credentials, reuse sessions, scrape the app, link accounts, move money, cancel subscriptions, negotiate bills, or assume Rocket Money's limited agency. Reconsider only if Rocket Money publishes a supported third-party member API or remote MCP contract with versioned schemas, least-privilege scopes, revocation, exact consumer/account binding, audit semantics, retention controls, and explicit confirmation for every write, linking, cancellation, negotiation, credit, subscription, billing, savings, ACH, or transfer action.

evidence.supports: Rocket Money documents linked financial accounts, transactions, subscriptions, budgets, credit reports, net worth, automated savings, subscription cancellation, bill negotiation, alerts, and premium financial tools inside its consumer product.

Rocket Money documents premium transaction writes, custom budgets and tags, manual transactions, credit reports, subscription cancellation, net worth, automatic savings, and synchronized linked-account data.
Rocket Money identifies Plaid as its secure linking provider and requires interactive in-app prompts to repair or reauthorize institution connections.

Rocket Money's current terms describe provider-operated Agent Services, account aggregation, limited agency for cancellations and bill negotiation, and ACH authority, while prohibiting robots, scraping, automated extraction, and reverse engineering; they publish no external member API contract transferable to Relay.
